subject: Fix Qodo review: infinite loop, race condition, SecureString leak, hardcoded string
body:
Fix Qodo review: infinite loop, race condition, SecureString leak, hardcoded string

- Fix infinite loop in StartupUnlockService for non-XML/legacy connection files:
  add IsParsableXml check to skip password prompt loop for unparseable files
- Fix race condition in Runtime.UpdateEncryptionKey: add lock to guard key swap
- Fix SecureString leak in Runtime.SetEncryptionKey(string): dispose temporary
- Replace hardcoded English error string with Language.StartupUnlockPasswordInvalid
- Add IsParsableXml method to XmlKeyValidator
- Add StartupUnlockPasswordInvalid localization string

security_flags.reason: credential and crypto paths need human review regardless of intent

triage.rationale: Patches fork-specific StartupUnlockService/XmlKeyValidator absent in our tree (verified); our Runtime.EncryptionKey differs; we shipped own MasterPasswordGate hardening (#128). Diff also risks use-after-dispose SecureString.
